{"content":"# gh-832 — Red validation verdicts loop forever — no convergence

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On an approved head whose validation CI repeatedly concludes red, the SM
machine never converges: it cycles `approved_queue → validating → approved_queue`
forever (live fa PR #1453: 12 dispatch→red→unarm→rearm cycles, 5 consecutive
FAILUREs, window idle 3.5h, no `validation_failed` park, no escalation). The stuck
quarantine PR fa #1470 could not merge because the loop burned the whole window.

**Root cause**: `fail_validation` (js/smAgent.js) has no convergence counter that
PARKS a red PR:

- **Machine-authored PRs are never parked.** The fail path only parks `validation_failed`
  for GUEST PRs (gh-757). A machine PR's only terminal guards are (a) the empty-lap
  cap (withholds the rework arm at the 3rd red on the same head) and (b) the
  `redHeadSkip` arm-side skip at `redHeadCap` (default 3) recorded 🔴 marker reds.
  Both are **per-head-SHA counters**, so every head refresh (silent-update/rework
  WIP push) resets them to zero — a fleet-wide flake riding in main makes every new
  head go red exactly once, so the caps never accumulate.
- **The terminal state is silent.** Even when the caps do fire, the outcome is a
  log line (`🚫 head already went red 3× — re-arm blocked`) — no park, no comment,
  no escalation. The red PR keeps matching `validate-armed` every tick; with the
  verdict probe momentarily non-failure (registration lag / cancelled interleave
  bypassing `deferRedHead`), the arm re-dispatches — the observed 12-cycle loop.

**Impact**: Any repeated red validation verdict on an approved head (fleet-wide
flake wave, broken main) burns CI and the single validation mutex indefinitely,
idles the merge window, and blocks unrelated recovery PRs (the quarantine PR itself
was stuck in the same loop). fa #1453 (12 cycles), fa #1470 (quarantine, stuck).

**Fix approach**: Convergence counter derived from the head's own dispatched run
history — the durable per-head record already fetched by the fail path:

- `streakFromRuns(runs, headSha)`: trailing count of consecutive concluded red
  verdict runs (`workflow_dispatch`, same head SHA, newest-first; `success` breaks
  the streak — AC2 green reset; `cancelled` is skipped per gh-755 — never a
  verdict; any other conclusion counts as red). A head change resets by
  construction (SHA-filtered — AC2 head-change reset).
- At `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (default **2**) consecutive reds on the unchanged
  head, the fail path PARKS the PR: `validation_failed` label + the report names
  the failing check job(s) (latest-per-context rollup, non-bookkeeping
  FAILURE/TIMED_OUT) + the existing failed-run link line. The parked PR leaves
  `validate-armed`'s FIFO (query excludes the label) → **no third dispatch** (AC1/AC3).
- Machine PRs keep the rework arm exactly as today (non-goal: red→rework routing
  unchanged) — the parked machine PR exits the park through the existing gh-750
  machine self-clear / #633 RESET probes once the rework push moves the head.
- One shared `github_list_workflow_runs` fetch feeds both the existing
  failed-run link line and the streak (no extra API pressure).
- Escape hatch: `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (0/false disables the park; the
  red-head marker recording and the 3-red arm-side skip are untouched).

{"content":"# gh-832 — Red validation verdicts loop forever — no convergence

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On an approved head whose validation CI repeatedly concludes red, the SM
machine never converges: it cycles `approved_queue → validating → approved_queue`
forever (live fa PR #1453: 12 dispatch→red→unarm→rearm cycles, 5 consecutive
FAILUREs, window idle 3.5h, no `validation_failed` park, no escalation). The stuck
quarantine PR fa #1470 could not merge because the loop burned the whole window.

**Root cause**: `fail_validation` (js/smAgent.js) has no convergence counter that
PARKS a red PR:

- **Machine-authored PRs are never parked.** The fail path only parks `validation_failed`
  for GUEST PRs (gh-757). A machine PR's only terminal guards are (a) the empty-lap
  cap (withholds the rework arm at the 3rd red on the same head) and (b) the
  `redHeadSkip` arm-side skip at `redHeadCap` (default 3) recorded 🔴 marker reds.
  Both are **per-head-SHA counters**, so every head refresh (silent-update/rework
  WIP push) resets them to zero — a fleet-wide flake riding in main makes every new
  head go red exactly once, so the caps never accumulate.
- **The terminal state is silent.** Even when the caps do fire, the outcome is a
  log line (`🚫 head already went red 3× — re-arm blocked`) — no park, no comment,
  no escalation. The red PR keeps matching `validate-armed` every tick; with the
  verdict probe momentarily non-failure (registration lag / cancelled interleave
  bypassing `deferRedHead`), the arm re-dispatches — the observed 12-cycle loop.

**Impact**: Any repeated red validation verdict on an approved head (fleet-wide
flake wave, broken main) burns CI and the single validation mutex indefinitely,
idles the merge window, and blocks unrelated recovery PRs (the quarantine PR itself
was stuck in the same loop). fa #1453 (12 cycles), fa #1470 (quarantine, stuck).

**Fix approach**: Convergence counter derived from the head's own dispatched run
history — the durable per-head record already fetched by the fail path:

- `streakFromRuns(runs, headSha)`: trailing count of consecutive concluded red
  verdict runs (`workflow_dispatch`, same head SHA, newest-first; `success` breaks
  the streak — AC2 green reset; `cancelled` is skipped per gh-755 — never a
  verdict; any other conclusion counts as red). A head change resets by
  construction (SHA-filtered — AC2 head-change reset).
- At `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (default **2**) consecutive reds on the unchanged
  head, the fail path PARKS the PR: `validation_failed` label + the report names
  the failing check job(s) (latest-per-context rollup, non-bookkeeping
  FAILURE/TIMED_OUT) + the existing failed-run link line. The parked PR leaves
  `validate-armed`'s FIFO (query excludes the label) → **no third dispatch** (AC1/AC3).
- Machine PRs keep the rework arm exactly as today (non-goal: red→rework routing
  unchanged) — the parked machine PR exits the park through the existing gh-750
  machine self-clear / #633 RESET probes once the rework push moves the head.
- One shared `github_list_workflow_runs` fetch feeds both the existing
  failed-run link line and the streak (no extra API pressure).
- Escape hatch: `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (0/false disables the park; the

{"content":"# gh-832 — Red validation verdicts loop forever — no convergence

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On an approved head whose validation CI repeatedly concludes red, the SM
machine never converges: it cycles `approved_queue → validating → approved_queue`
forever (live fa PR #1453: 12 dispatch→red→unarm→rearm cycles, 5 consecutive
FAILUREs, window idle 3.5h, no `validation_failed` park, no escalation). The stuck
quarantine PR fa #1470 could not merge because the loop burned the whole window.

**Root cause**: `fail_validation` (js/smAgent.js) has no convergence counter that
PARKS a red PR:

- **Machine-authored PRs are never parked.** The fail path only parks `validation_failed`
  for GUEST PRs (gh-757). A machine PR's only terminal guards are (a) the empty-lap
  cap (withholds the rework arm at the 3rd red on the same head) and (b) the
  `redHeadSkip` arm-side skip at `redHeadCap` (default 3) recorded 🔴 marker reds.
  Both are **per-head-SHA counters**, so every head refresh (silent-update/rework
  WIP push) resets them to zero — a fleet-wide flake riding in main makes every new
  head go red exactly once, so the caps never accumulate.
- **The terminal state is silent.** Even when the caps do fire, the outcome is a
  log line (`🚫 head already went red 3× — re-arm blocked`) — no park, no comment,
  no escalation. The red PR keeps matching `validate-armed` every tick; with the
  verdict probe momentarily non-failure (registration lag / cancelled interleave
  bypassing `deferRedHead`), the arm re-dispatches — the observed 12-cycle loop.

**Impact**: Any repeated red validation verdict on an approved head (fleet-wide
flake wave, broken main) burns CI and the single validation mutex indefinitely,
idles the merge window, and blocks unrelated recovery PRs (the quarantine PR itself
was stuck in the same loop). fa #1453 (12 cycles), fa #1470 (quarantine, stuck).

**Fix approach**: Convergence counter derived from the head's own dispatched run
history — the durable per-head record already fetched by the fail path:

- `streakFromRuns(runs, headSha)`: trailing count of consecutive concluded red
  verdict runs (`workflow_dispatch`, same head SHA, newest-first; `success` breaks
  the streak — AC2 green reset; `cancelled` is skipped per gh-755 — never a
  verdict; any other conclusion counts as red). A head change resets by
  construction (SHA-filtered — AC2 head-change reset).
- At `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (default **2**) consecutive reds on the unchanged
  head, the fail path PARKS the PR: `validation_failed` label + the report names
  the failing check job(s) (latest-per-context rollup, non-bookkeeping
  FAILURE/TIMED_OUT) + the existing failed-run link line. The parked PR leaves
  `validate-armed`'s FIFO (query excludes the label) → **no third dispatch** (AC1/AC3).
- Machine PRs keep the rework arm exactly as today (non-goal: red→rework routing
  unchanged) — the parked machine PR exits the park through the existing gh-750
  machine self-clear / #633 RESET probes once the rework push moves the head.
- One shared `github_list_workflow_runs` fetch feeds both the existing
  failed-run link line and the streak (no extra API pressure).
- Escape hatch: `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (0/false disables the park; the
  red-head marker recording and the 3-red arm-side skip are untouched).

{"content":"# gh-832 — Red validation verdicts loop forever — no convergence

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On an approved head whose validation CI repeatedly concludes red, the SM
machine never converges: it cycles `approved_queue → validating → approved_queue`
forever (live fa PR #1453: 12 dispatch→red→unarm→rearm cycles, 5 consecutive
FAILUREs, window idle 3.5h, no `validation_failed` park, no escalation). The stuck
quarantine PR fa #1470 could not merge because the loop burned the whole window.

**Root cause**: `fail_validation` (js/smAgent.js) has no convergence counter that
PARKS a red PR:

- **Machine-authored PRs are never parked.** The fail path only parks `validation_failed`
  for GUEST PRs (gh-757). A machine PR's only terminal guards are (a) the empty-lap
  cap (withholds the rework arm at the 3rd red on the same head) and (b) the
  `redHeadSkip` arm-side skip at `redHeadCap` (default 3) recorded 🔴 marker reds.
  Both are **per-head-SHA counters**, so every head refresh (silent-update/rework
  WIP push) resets them to zero — a fleet-wide flake riding in main makes every new
  head go red exactly once, so the caps never accumulate.
- **The terminal state is silent.** Even when the caps do fire, the outcome is a
  log line (`🚫 head already went red 3× — re-arm blocked`) — no park, no comment,
  no escalation. The red PR keeps matching `validate-armed` every tick; with the
  verdict probe momentarily non-failure (registration lag / cancelled interleave
  bypassing `deferRedHead`), the arm re-dispatches — the observed 12-cycle loop.

**Impact**: Any repeated red validation verdict on an approved head (fleet-wide
flake wave, broken main) burns CI and the single validation mutex indefinitely,
idles the merge window, and blocks unrelated recovery PRs (the quarantine PR itself
was stuck in the same loop). fa #1453 (12 cycles), fa #1470 (quarantine, stuck).

**Fix approach**: Convergence counter derived from the head's own dispatched run
history — the durable per-head record already fetched by the fail path:

- `streakFromRuns(runs, headSha)`: trailing count of consecutive concluded red
  verdict runs (`workflow_dispatch`, same head SHA, newest-first; `success` breaks
  the streak — AC2 green reset; `cancelled` is skipped per gh-755 — never a
  verdict; any other conclusion counts as red). A head change resets by
  construction (SHA-filtered — AC2 head-change reset).
- At `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (default **2**) consecutive reds on the unchanged
  head, the fail path PARKS the PR: `validation_failed` label + the report names
  the failing check job(s) (latest-per-context rollup, non-bookkeeping
  FAILURE/TIMED_OUT) + the existing failed-run link line. The parked PR leaves
  `validate-armed`'s FIFO (query excludes the label) → **no third dispatch** (AC1/AC3).
- Machine PRs keep the rework arm exactly as today (non-goal: red→rework routing
  unchanged) — the parked machine PR exits the park through the existing gh-750
  machine self-clear / #633 RESET probes once the rework push moves the head.
- One shared `github_list_workflow_runs` fetch feeds both the existing
  failed-run link line and the streak (no extra API pressure).
- Escape hatch: `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (0/false disables the park; the
  red-head marker recording and the 3-red arm-side skip are untouched).

blocks.text:
Now, let me trace the actual bug. The scenario: PR #1453, machine-authored (its rework arms), head unchanged, 5 reds in a row, 12 cycles.

Trace per red for a machine PR with unchanged head:
- Red 1: fail_validation → report + 🔴 red head sha — red 1/3 marker; machine → arm rework (linked issue or PR-anchored). Unarm.
- Rework leg runs... does it push? If the rework leg pushes nothing (empty lap) the head stays. If the leg pushes a WIP save, the head moves and red-head counter resets. The ticket says "head unchanged" — the rework leg apparently pushed nothing OR the arm didn't fire.

Actually wait — reconsider: "12 dispatch→red→unarm→rearm cycles" with "5× concluded FAILURE". What if the rework arm never fires because of the rework latch (gh-806)? `consultReworkLatch(key, ticket, ...)` — if a leg is latched as in-flight (but dead), the arm is suppressed forever. Hmm.

But more importantly: what does the ticket ask for? AC1: **two consecutive red verdicts with unchanged head ⇒ second red parks validation_failed + explanatory comment; no third dispatch.** AC2: green resets, head change resets. The capability surface: "Convergence counter: per-head consecutive-red count in fa-state; on red verdict with unchanged head ⇒ increment. At 2 consecutive reds: park validation_failed + comment naming the failing job(s) + link the latest run."

The current code parks only GUEST PRs at red 1, and machine PRs converge (at best) at red 3 via redHeadSkip (which merely *skips the re-arm* — the PR silently sits out the window but the rule keeps matching it? Actually `continue` without processedKeys — the rule limit-1 slot moves on to the NEXT approved PR, so the window continues). But the ticket says even that didn't happen — 12 cycles.

So why did the existing guards fail in the live instance? Let me think about what's broken:

1. `redHeadSkip` on validate-armed: checks `redHeadBlocked(effectiveRepoInfo, ticket.prNumber, vHead0, rhCap)` — reads marker comments. The markers are recorded by fail_validation. If fail_validation ran, markers recorded. After 3 reds, re-arm blocked. 5 reds happened → so markers must NOT have been recorded or not parsed.

Wait, actually — check `redHeadMarkerLine(priorReds, failHead, redCap)`: marker is `🔴 red head <sha> — red N/3 ...`. `priorReds = failHead ? (failMarks.redHeads[failHead] || 0) : 0`. And RED_HEAD_MARKER_RE parses `([0-9a-f]{7,40})`. Full SHA is 40 hex — matches. Then on re-arm, redHeadBlocked checks `hist[headSha] >= cap`. headSha = vHead0 from ticket.pr.headSha — full 40-char sha. Marker recorded with failHead = same. So parse works.

Hmm, so if the machine-author PR went through fail_validation 5 times, red-head skip would block re-arm #4. Unless... the head moved between reds (rework leg WIP saves) — then each red is on a new SHA, counter resets, and the loop continues with a *changing* head. The ticket claims "head unchanged" though. Hmm, but actually let me re-read: "after N consecutive reds with no head change the machine parks". The live instance: "PR #1453 cycled approved_queue → validating → approved_queue 12 times; its dispatched validations concluded FAILURE 5× in a row". 12 cycles ≠ 5 reds. So 7 cycles had no concluded failure — dispatch→(cancelled or pending forever?)→... Actually a cycle requires returning to approved_queue, which requires un-arming. What un-arms without a red verdict? `unarm-stale-validation` (BEHIND) or `sweep-stale-validating` (stale arm). Or... `unarm_validation` when mergeState BEHIND. And `sweep` with a concluded red routes into "standard fail handling" (sweepFailure=true) → same fail path with markers.

OK. I can't reconstruct the exact live mechanics beyond what the ticket states. The ticket's *requirement* is a fresh capability: a per-head consecutive-red convergence counter in fa-state that at 2 consecutive reds (head unchanged) parks `validation_failed` + comment naming the failing job(s) + link — for ANY PR (machine or guest). This is the "red-verdict sibling" of gh-821 (zombie mutex). 

Wait, but maybe the root cause is identifiable in code: the `fail_validation` action for machine PRs NEVER parks — it relies on (a) rework arm, (b) empty-lap cap at red 3, (c) red-head skip at 3. But there's a hole: the rework arm fires on EVERY red unless emptyLapMax reached. With emptyLapMax=1: red1 → arm; lap empty; red2 → marker "empty lap 1/1" recorded, arm NOT withheld (0 >= 1 false)... wait, re-check:

```
var emptyLaps = priorRedOnHead && failHead ? (failMarks.emptyLaps[failHead] || 0) : 0;
var reworkEmptyCapped = isMachinePr && priorRedOnHead && emptyLaps >= lapMax;
```

red2: priorReds=1 → priorRedOnHead=true; emptyLaps=0; lapMax=1 → 0>=1 false → arm fires, report records "empty rework lap 1/1 — LAST CHANCE". red3: emptyLaps=1 >= 1 → capped → withheld + escalation comment. So the machine converges at red 3 with an escalation comment. And redHeadSkip blocks re-arm #4. So in theory machine PRs converge at 3.

BUT the hole: this all depends on the rework arm actually firing between reds and the lap being "empty". What if the rework leg pushes a WIP autosave (timer auto-commit!) — the timer in the teammate leg pushes WIP saves periodically. Then the head MOVES → new SHA → red-head counter resets → empty laps keyed to old SHA → the whole guard family never fires. The new head validates → red (the flake is in main? no wait, the flake is a test in the repo — the quarantine PR #1470 removes it, but #1453's head contains the flaky test since it's based on main before the quarantine merges). So every new head re-runs the flaky test → red. Each red on a NEW head = counter reset = loop forever. The empty-lap cap only counts reds on the SAME head; red-head skip only blocks heads that went red 3× — but each head goes red only ONCE (the rework leg pushes a new head after each red!). 

Hmm but the ticket says "head unchanged". Hmm: "12 dispatch→red→unarm→rearm cycles on fa #1453". Let me re-read... "Repeated RED validation verdicts on an approved head must CONVERGE: after N consecutive reds with no head change the machine parks". The live subject says the cycles happened; whether the head changed between cycles is not entirely explicit, but "with no head change" is the convergence condition. The quarantine PR #1470 stuck "in the same loop" — a quarantine PR edits the quarantine list file (removes/adds test paths), and its validation would run the suite... if the flake is still present on its head (based on old main), it goes red too.

I can't verify the live details beyond the ticket. What matters for the fix per ACs:

- AC1: sim — approved head, two consecutive red verdicts, head unchanged ⇒ second red parks validation_failed + explanatory comment; no third dispatch.
- AC2: green resets counter; head change resets counter.
- AC3: replay #1453 12-cycle timeline — parks at cycle 2 with the PTY shard named.
- Test plan L1: unit tests (counter, reset conditions, park action); L2: replay.

{"content":"# gh-832 — Red validation verdicts loop forever — no convergence

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On an approved head whose validation CI repeatedly concludes red, the SM
machine never converges: it cycles `approved_queue → validating → approved_queue`
forever (live fa PR #1453: 12 dispatch→red→unarm→rearm cycles, 5 consecutive
FAILUREs, window idle 3.5h, no `validation_failed` park, no escalation). The stuck
quarantine PR fa #1470 could not merge because the loop burned the whole window.

**Root cause**: `fail_validation` (js/smAgent.js) has no convergence counter that
PARKS a red PR:

- **Machine-authored PRs are never parked.** The fail path only parks `validation_failed`
  for GUEST PRs (gh-757). A machine PR's only terminal guards are (a) the empty-lap
  cap (withholds the rework arm at the 3rd red on the same head) and (b) the
  `redHeadSkip` arm-side skip at `redHeadCap` (default 3) recorded 🔴 marker reds.
  Both are **per-head-SHA counters**, so every head refresh (silent-update/rework
  WIP push) resets them to zero — a fleet-wide flake riding in main makes every new
  head go red exactly once, so the caps never accumulate.
- **The terminal state is silent.** Even when the caps do fire, the outcome is a
  log line (`🚫 head already went red 3× — re-arm blocked`) — no park, no comment,
  no escalation. The red PR keeps matching `validate-armed` every tick; with the
  verdict probe momentarily non-failure (registration lag / cancelled interleave
  bypassing `deferRedHead`), the arm re-dispatches — the observed 12-cycle loop.

**Impact**: Any repeated red validation verdict on an approved head (fleet-wide
flake wave, broken main) burns CI and the single validation mutex indefinitely,
idles the merge window, and blocks unrelated recovery PRs (the quarantine PR itself
was stuck in the same loop). fa #1453 (12 cycles), fa #1470 (quarantine, stuck).

**Fix approach**: Convergence counter derived from the head's own dispatched run
history — the durable per-head record already fetched by the fail path:

- `streakFromRuns(runs, headSha)`: trailing count of consecutive concluded red
  verdict runs (`workflow_dispatch`, same head SHA, newest-first; `success` breaks
  the streak — AC2 green reset; `cancelled` is skipped per gh-755 — never a
  verdict; any other conclusion counts as red). A head change resets by
  construction (SHA-filtered — AC2 head-change reset).
- At `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (default **2**) consecutive reds on the unchanged
  head, the fail path PARKS the PR: `validation_failed` label + the report names
  the failing check job(s) (latest-per-context rollup, non-bookkeeping
  FAILURE/TIMED_OUT) + the existing failed-run link line. The parked PR leaves
  `validate-armed`'s FIFO (query excludes the label) → **no third dispatch** (AC1/AC3).
- Machine PRs keep the rework arm exactly as today (non-goal: red→rework routing
  unchanged) — the parked machine PR exits the park through the existing gh-750
  machine self-clear / #633 RESET probes once the rework push moves the head.
- One shared `github_list_workflow_runs` fetch feeds both the existing
  failed-run link line and the streak (no extra API pressure).
- Escape hatch: `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (0/false disables the park; the
  red-head marker recording and the 3-red arm-side skip are untouched).

{"content":"# gh-832 — Red validation verdicts loop forever — no convergence

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On an approved head whose validation CI repeatedly concludes red, the SM
machine never converges: it cycles `approved_queue → validating → approved_queue`
forever (live fa PR #1453: 12 dispatch→red→unarm→rearm cycles, 5 consecutive
FAILUREs, window idle 3.5h, no `validation_failed` park, no escalation). The stuck
quarantine PR fa #1470 could not merge because the loop burned the whole window.

**Root cause**: `fail_validation` (js/smAgent.js) has no convergence counter that
PARKS a red PR:

- **Machine-authored PRs are never parked.** The fail path only parks `validation_failed`
  for GUEST PRs (gh-757). A machine PR's only terminal guards are (a) the empty-lap
  cap (withholds the rework arm at the 3rd red on the same head) and (b) the
  `redHeadSkip` arm-side skip at `redHeadCap` (default 3) recorded 🔴 marker reds.
  Both are **per-head-SHA counters**, so every head refresh (silent-update/rework
  WIP push) resets them to zero — a fleet-wide flake riding in main makes every new
  head go red exactly once, so the caps never accumulate.
- **The terminal state is silent.** Even when the caps do fire, the outcome is a
  log line (`🚫 head already went red 3× — re-arm blocked`) — no park, no comment,
  no escalation. The red PR keeps matching `validate-armed` every tick; with the
  verdict probe momentarily non-failure (registration lag / cancelled interleave
  bypassing `deferRedHead`), the arm re-dispatches — the observed 12-cycle loop.

**Impact**: Any repeated red validation verdict on an approved head (fleet-wide
flake wave, broken main) burns CI and the single validation mutex indefinitely,
idles the merge window, and blocks unrelated recovery PRs (the quarantine PR itself
was stuck in the same loop). fa #1453 (12 cycles), fa #1470 (quarantine, stuck).

**Fix approach**: Convergence counter derived from the head's own dispatched run
history — the durable per-head record already fetched by the fail path:

- `streakFromRuns(runs, headSha)`: trailing count of consecutive concluded red
  verdict runs (`workflow_dispatch`, same head SHA, newest-first; `success` breaks
  the streak — AC2 green reset; `cancelled` is skipped per gh-755 — never a
  verdict; any other conclusion counts as red). A head change resets by
  construction (SHA-filtered — AC2 head-change reset).
- At `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (default **2**) consecutive reds on the unchanged
  head, the fail path PARKS the PR: `validation_failed` label + the report names
  the failing check job(s) (latest-per-context rollup, non-bookkeeping
  FAILURE/TIMED_OUT) + the existing failed-run link line. The parked PR leaves
  `validate-armed`'s FIFO (query excludes the label) → **no third dispatch** (AC1/AC3).
- Machine PRs keep the rework arm exactly as today (non-goal: red→rework routing
  unchanged) — the parked machine PR exits the park through the existing gh-750
  machine self-clear / #633 RESET probes once the rework push moves the head.
- One shared `github_list_workflow_runs` fetch feeds both the existing
  failed-run link line and the streak (no extra API pressure).
- Escape hatch: `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (0/false disables the park; the
  red-head marker recording and the 3-red arm-side skip are untouched).

{"content":"# gh-832 — Red validation verdicts loop forever — no convergence

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On an approved head whose validation CI repeatedly concludes red, the SM
machine never converges: it cycles `approved_queue → validating → approved_queue`
forever (live fa PR #1453: 12 dispatch→red→unarm→rearm cycles, 5 consecutive
FAILUREs, window idle 3.5h, no `validation_failed` park, no escalation). The stuck
quarantine PR fa #1470 could not merge because the loop burned the whole window.

**Root cause**: `fail_validation` (js/smAgent.js) has no convergence counter that
PARKS a red PR:

- **Machine-authored PRs are never parked.** The fail path only parks `validation_failed`
  for GUEST PRs (gh-757). A machine PR's only terminal guards are (a) the empty-lap
  cap (withholds the rework arm at the 3rd red on the same head) and (b) the
  `redHeadSkip` arm-side skip at `redHeadCap` (default 3) recorded 🔴 marker reds.
  Both are **per-head-SHA counters**, so every head refresh (silent-update/rework
  WIP push) resets them to zero — a fleet-wide flake riding in main makes every new
  head go red exactly once, so the caps never accumulate.
- **The terminal state is silent.** Even when the caps do fire, the outcome is a
  log line (`🚫 head already went red 3× — re-arm blocked`) — no park, no comment,
  no escalation. The red PR keeps matching `validate-armed` every tick; with the
  verdict probe momentarily non-failure (registration lag / cancelled interleave
  bypassing `deferRedHead`), the arm re-dispatches — the observed 12-cycle loop.

**Impact**: Any repeated red validation verdict on an approved head (fleet-wide
flake wave, broken main) burns CI and the single validation mutex indefinitely,
idles the merge window, and blocks unrelated recovery PRs (the quarantine PR itself
was stuck in the same loop). fa #1453 (12 cycles), fa #1470 (quarantine, stuck).

**Fix approach**: Convergence counter derived from the head's own dispatched run
history — the durable per-head record already fetched by the fail path:

- `streakFromRuns(runs, headSha)`: trailing count of consecutive concluded red
  verdict runs (`workflow_dispatch`, same head SHA, newest-first; `success` breaks
  the streak — AC2 green reset; `cancelled` is skipped per gh-755 — never a
  verdict; any other conclusion counts as red). A head change resets by
  construction (SHA-filtered — AC2 head-change reset).
- At `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (default **2**) consecutive reds on the unchanged
  head, the fail path PARKS the PR: `validation_failed` label + the report names
  the failing check job(s) (latest-per-context rollup, non-bookkeeping
  FAILURE/TIMED_OUT) + the existing failed-run link line. The parked PR leaves
  `validate-armed`'s FIFO (query excludes the label) → **no third dispatch** (AC1/AC3).
- Machine PRs keep the rework arm exactly as today (non-goal: red→rework routing
  unchanged) — the parked machine PR exits the park through the existing gh-750
  machine self-clear / #633 RESET probes once the rework push moves the head.
- One shared `github_list_workflow_runs` fetch feeds both the existing
  failed-run link line and the streak (no extra API pressure).
- Escape hatch: `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (0/false disables the park; the
  red-head marker recording and the 3-red arm-side skip are untouched).

{"content":"# gh-832 — Red validation verdicts loop forever — no convergence

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On an approved head whose validation CI repeatedly concludes red, the SM
machine never converges: it cycles `approved_queue → validating → approved_queue`
forever (live fa PR #1453: 12 dispatch→red→unarm→rearm cycles, 5 consecutive
FAILUREs, window idle 3.5h, no `validation_failed` park, no escalation). The stuck
quarantine PR fa #1470 could not merge because the loop burned the whole window.

**Root cause**: `fail_validation` (js/smAgent.js) has no convergence counter that
PARKS a red PR:

- **Machine-authored PRs are never parked.** The fail path only parks `validation_failed`
  for GUEST PRs (gh-757). A machine PR's only terminal guards are (a) the empty-lap
  cap (withholds the rework arm at the 3rd red on the same head) and (b) the
  `redHeadSkip` arm-side skip at `redHeadCap` (default 3) recorded 🔴 marker reds.
  Both are **per-head-SHA counters**, so every head refresh (silent-update/rework
  WIP push) resets them to zero — a fleet-wide flake riding in main makes every new
  head go red exactly once, so the caps never accumulate.
- **The terminal state is silent.** Even when the caps do fire, the outcome is a
  log line (`🚫 head already went red 3× — re-arm blocked`) — no park, no comment,
  no escalation. The red PR keeps matching `validate-armed` every tick; with the
  verdict probe momentarily non-failure (registration lag / cancelled interleave
  bypassing `deferRedHead`), the arm re-dispatches — the observed 12-cycle loop.

**Impact**: Any repeated red validation verdict on an approved head (fleet-wide
flake wave, broken main) burns CI and the single validation mutex indefinitely,
idles the merge window, and blocks unrelated recovery PRs (the quarantine PR itself
was stuck in the same loop). fa #1453 (12 cycles), fa #1470 (quarantine, stuck).

**Fix approach**: Convergence counter derived from the head's own dispatched run
history — the durable per-head record already fetched by the fail path:

- `streakFromRuns(runs, headSha)`: trailing count of consecutive concluded red
  verdict runs (`workflow_dispatch`, same head SHA, newest-first; `success` breaks
  the streak — AC2 green reset; `cancelled` is skipped per gh-755 — never a
  verdict; any other conclusion counts as red). A head change resets by
  construction (SHA-filtered — AC2 head-change reset).
- At `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (default **2**) consecutive reds on the unchanged
  head, the fail path PARKS the PR: `validation_failed` label + the report names
  the failing check job(s) (latest-per-context rollup, non-bookkeeping
  FAILURE/TIMED_OUT) + the existing failed-run link line. The parked PR leaves
  `validate-armed`'s FIFO (query excludes the label) → **no third dispatch** (AC1/AC3).
- Machine PRs keep the rework arm exactly as today (non-goal: red→rework routing
  unchanged) — the parked machine PR exits the park through the existing gh-750
  machine self-clear / #633 RESET probes once the rework push moves the head.
- One shared `github_list_workflow_runs` fetch feeds both the existing
  failed-run link line and the streak (no extra API pressure).
- Escape hatch: `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (0/false disables the park; the
  red-head marker recording and the 3-red arm-side skip are untouched).

{"content":"# gh-832 — Red validation verdicts loop forever — no convergence

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On an approved head whose validation CI repeatedly concludes red, the SM
machine never converges: it cycles `approved_queue → validating → approved_queue`
forever (live fa PR #1453: 12 dispatch→red→unarm→rearm cycles, 5 consecutive
FAILUREs, window idle 3.5h, no `validation_failed` park, no escalation). The stuck
quarantine PR fa #1470 could not merge because the loop burned the whole window.

**Root cause**: `fail_validation` (js/smAgent.js) has no convergence counter that
PARKS a red PR:

- **Machine-authored PRs are never parked.** The fail path only parks `validation_failed`
  for GUEST PRs (gh-757). A machine PR's only terminal guards are (a) the empty-lap
  cap (withholds the rework arm at the 3rd red on the same head) and (b) the
  `redHeadSkip` arm-side skip at `redHeadCap` (default 3) recorded 🔴 marker reds.
  Both are **per-head-SHA counters**, so every head refresh (silent-update/rework
  WIP push) resets them to zero — a fleet-wide flake riding in main makes every new
  head go red exactly once, so the caps never accumulate.
- **The terminal state is silent.** Even when the caps do fire, the outcome is a
  log line (`🚫 head already went red 3× — re-arm blocked`) — no park, no comment,
  no escalation. The red PR keeps matching `validate-armed` every tick; with the
  verdict probe momentarily non-failure (registration lag / cancelled interleave
  bypassing `deferRedHead`), the arm re-dispatches — the observed 12-cycle loop.

**Impact**: Any repeated red validation verdict on an approved head (fleet-wide
flake wave, broken main) burns CI and the single validation mutex indefinitely,
idles the merge window, and blocks unrelated recovery PRs (the quarantine PR itself
was stuck in the same loop). fa #1453 (12 cycles), fa #1470 (quarantine, stuck).

**Fix approach**: Convergence counter derived from the head's own dispatched run
history — the durable per-head record already fetched by the fail path:

- `streakFromRuns(runs, headSha)`: trailing count of consecutive concluded red
  verdict runs (`workflow_dispatch`, same head SHA, newest-first; `success` breaks
  the streak — AC2 green reset; `cancelled` is skipped per gh-755 — never a
  verdict; any other conclusion counts as red). A head change resets by
  construction (SHA-filtered — AC2 head-change reset).
- At `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (default **2**) consecutive reds on the unchanged
  head, the fail path PARKS the PR: `validation_failed` label + the report names
  the failing check job(s) (latest-per-context rollup, non-bookkeeping
  FAILURE/TIMED_OUT) + the existing failed-run link line. The parked PR leaves
  `validate-armed`'s FIFO (query excludes the label) → **no third dispatch** (AC1/AC3).
- Machine PRs keep the rework arm exactly as today (non-goal: red→rework routing
  unchanged) — the parked machine PR exits the park through the existing gh-750
  machine self-clear / #633 RESET probes once the rework push moves the head.
- One shared `github_list_workflow_runs` fetch feeds both the existing
  failed-run link line and the streak (no extra API pressure).
- Escape hatch: `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (0/false disables the park; the
  red-head marker recording and the 3-red arm-side skip are untouched).

{"content":"# gh-832 — Red validation verdicts loop forever — no convergence

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On an approved head whose validation CI repeatedly concludes red, the SM
machine never converges: it cycles `approved_queue → validating → approved_queue`
forever (live fa PR #1453: 12 dispatch→red→unarm→rearm cycles, 5 consecutive
FAILUREs, window idle 3.5h, no `validation_failed` park, no escalation). The stuck
quarantine PR fa #1470 could not merge because the loop burned the whole window.

**Root cause**: `fail_validation` (js/smAgent.js) has no convergence counter that
PARKS a red PR:

- **Machine-authored PRs are never parked.** The fail path only parks `validation_failed`
  for GUEST PRs (gh-757). A machine PR's only terminal guards are (a) the empty-lap
  cap (withholds the rework arm at the 3rd red on the same head) and (b) the
  `redHeadSkip` arm-side skip at `redHeadCap` (default 3) recorded 🔴 marker reds.
  Both are **per-head-SHA counters**, so every head refresh (silent-update/rework
  WIP push) resets them to zero — a fleet-wide flake riding in main makes every new
  head go red exactly once, so the caps never accumulate.
- **The terminal state is silent.** Even when the caps do fire, the outcome is a
  log line (`🚫 head already went red 3× — re-arm blocked`) — no park, no comment,
  no escalation. The red PR keeps matching `validate-armed` every tick; with the
  verdict probe momentarily non-failure (registration lag / cancelled interleave
  bypassing `deferRedHead`), the arm re-dispatches — the observed 12-cycle loop.

**Impact**: Any repeated red validation verdict on an approved head (fleet-wide
flake wave, broken main) burns CI and the single validation mutex indefinitely,
idles the merge window, and blocks unrelated recovery PRs (the quarantine PR itself
was stuck in the same loop). fa #1453 (12 cycles), fa #1470 (quarantine, stuck).

**Fix approach**: Convergence counter derived from the head's own dispatched run
history — the durable per-head record already fetched by the fail path:

- `streakFromRuns(runs, headSha)`: trailing count of consecutive concluded red
  verdict runs (`workflow_dispatch`, same head SHA, newest-first; `success` breaks
  the streak — AC2 green reset; `cancelled` is skipped per gh-755 — never a
  verdict; any other conclusion counts as red). A head change resets by
  construction (SHA-filtered — AC2 head-change reset).

{"content":"# gh-832 — Red validation verdicts loop forever — no convergence

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On an approved head whose validation CI repeatedly concludes red, the SM
machine never converges: it cycles `approved_queue → validating → approved_queue`
forever (live fa PR #1453: 12 dispatch→red→unarm→rearm cycles, 5 consecutive
FAILUREs, window idle 3.5h, no `validation_failed` park, no escalation). The stuck
quarantine PR fa #1470 could not merge because the loop burned the whole window.

**Root cause**: `fail_validation` (js/smAgent.js) has no convergence counter that
PARKS a red PR:

- **Machine-authored PRs are never parked.** The fail path only parks `validation_failed`
  for GUEST PRs (gh-757). A machine PR's only terminal guards are (a) the empty-lap
  cap (withholds the rework arm at the 3rd red on the same head) and (b) the
  `redHeadSkip` arm-side skip at `redHeadCap` (default 3) recorded 🔴 marker reds.
  Both are **per-head-SHA counters**, so every head refresh (silent-update/rework
  WIP push) resets them to zero — a fleet-wide flake riding in main makes every new
  head go red exactly once, so the caps never accumulate.
- **The terminal state is silent.** Even when the caps do fire, the outcome is a
  log line (`🚫 head already went red 3× — re-arm blocked`) — no park, no comment,
  no escalation. The red PR keeps matching `validate-armed` every tick; with the
  verdict probe momentarily non-failure (registration lag / cancelled interleave
  bypassing `deferRedHead`), the arm re-dispatches — the observed 12-cycle loop.

**Impact**: Any repeated red validation verdict on an approved head (fleet-wide
flake wave, broken main) burns CI and the single validation mutex indefinitely,
idles the merge window, and blocks unrelated recovery PRs (the quarantine PR itself
was stuck in the same loop). fa #1453 (12 cycles), fa #1470 (quarantine, stuck).

**Fix approach**: Convergence counter derived from the head's own dispatched run
history — the durable per-head record already fetched by the fail path:

- `streakFromRuns(runs, headSha)`: trailing count of consecutive concluded red
  verdict runs (`workflow_dispatch`, same head SHA, newest-first; `success` breaks
  the streak — AC2 green reset; `cancelled` is skipped per gh-755 — never a
  verdict; any other conclusion counts as red). A head change resets by
  construction (SHA-filtered — AC2 head-change reset).
- At `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (default **2**) consecutive reds on the unchanged

{"content":"# gh-832 — Red validation verdicts loop forever — no convergence

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On an approved head whose validation CI repeatedly concludes red, the SM
machine never converges: it cycles `approved_queue → validating → approved_queue`
forever (live fa PR #1453: 12 dispatch→red→unarm→rearm cycles, 5 consecutive
FAILUREs, window idle 3.5h, no `validation_failed` park, no escalation). The stuck
quarantine PR fa #1470 could not merge because the loop burned the whole window.

**Root cause**: `fail_validation` (js/smAgent.js) has no convergence counter that
PARKS a red PR:

- **Machine-authored PRs are never parked.** The fail path only parks `validation_failed`
  for GUEST PRs (gh-757). A machine PR's only terminal guards are (a) the empty-lap
  cap (withholds the rework arm at the 3rd red on the same head) and (b) the
  `redHeadSkip` arm-side skip at `redHeadCap` (default 3) recorded 🔴 marker reds.
  Both are **per-head-SHA counters**, so every head refresh (silent-update/rework
  WIP push) resets them to zero — a fleet-wide flake riding in main makes every new
  head go red exactly once, so the caps never accumulate.
- **The terminal state is silent.** Even when the caps do fire, the outcome is a
  log line (`🚫 head already went red 3× — re-arm blocked`) — no park, no comment,
  no escalation. The red PR keeps matching `validate-armed` every tick; with the
  verdict probe momentarily non-failure (registration lag / cancelled interleave
  bypassing `deferRedHead`), the arm re-dispatches — the observed 12-cycle loop.

**Impact**: Any repeated red validation verdict on an approved head (fleet-wide
flake wave, broken main) burns CI and the single validation mutex indefinitely,
idles the merge window, and blocks unrelated recovery PRs (the quarantine PR itself
was stuck in the same loop). fa #1453 (12 cycles), fa #1470 (quarantine, stuck).

**Fix approach**: Convergence counter derived from the head's own dispatched run
history — the durable per-head record already fetched by the fail path:

- `streakFromRuns(runs, headSha)`: trailing count of consecutive concluded red
  verdict runs (`workflow_dispatch`, same head SHA, newest-first; `success` breaks
  the streak — AC2 green reset; `cancelled` is skipped per gh-755 — never a
  verdict; any other conclusion counts as red). A head change resets by
  construction (SHA-filtered — AC2 head-change reset).
- At `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (default **2**) consecutive reds on the unchanged
  head, the fail path PARKS the PR: `validation_failed` label + the report names

{"content":"# gh-832 — Red validation verdicts loop forever — no convergence

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On an approved head whose validation CI repeatedly concludes red, the SM
machine never converges: it cycles `approved_queue → validating → approved_queue`
forever (live fa PR #1453: 12 dispatch→red→unarm→rearm cycles, 5 consecutive
FAILUREs, window idle 3.5h, no `validation_failed` park, no escalation). The stuck
quarantine PR fa #1470 could not merge because the loop burned the whole window.

**Root cause**: `fail_validation` (js/smAgent.js) has no convergence counter that
PARKS a red PR:

- **Machine-authored PRs are never parked.** The fail path only parks `validation_failed`
  for GUEST PRs (gh-757). A machine PR's only terminal guards are (a) the empty-lap
  cap (withholds the rework arm at the 3rd red on the same head) and (b) the
  `redHeadSkip` arm-side skip at `redHeadCap` (default 3) recorded 🔴 marker reds.
  Both are **per-head-SHA counters**, so every head refresh (silent-update/rework
  WIP push) resets them to zero — a fleet-wide flake riding in main makes every new
  head go red exactly once, so the caps never accumulate.
- **The terminal state is silent.** Even when the caps do fire, the outcome is a
  log line (`🚫 head already went red 3× — re-arm blocked`) — no park, no comment,
  no escalation. The red PR keeps matching `validate-armed` every tick; with the
  verdict probe momentarily non-failure (registration lag / cancelled interleave
  bypassing `deferRedHead`), the arm re-dispatches — the observed 12-cycle loop.

**Impact**: Any repeated red validation verdict on an approved head (fleet-wide
flake wave, broken main) burns CI and the single validation mutex indefinitely,
idles the merge window, and blocks unrelated recovery PRs (the quarantine PR itself
was stuck in the same loop). fa #1453 (12 cycles), fa #1470 (quarantine, stuck).

**Fix approach**: Convergence counter derived from the head's own dispatched run
history — the durable per-head record already fetched by the fail path:

- `streakFromRuns(runs, headSha)`: trailing count of consecutive concluded red
  verdict runs (`workflow_dispatch`, same head SHA, newest-first; `success` breaks
  the streak — AC2 green reset; `cancelled` is skipped per gh-755 — never a
  verdict; any other conclusion counts as red). A head change resets by
  construction (SHA-filtered — AC2 head-change reset).
- At `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (default **2**) consecutive reds on the unchanged
  head, the fail path PARKS the PR: `validation_failed` label + the report names
  the failing check job(s) (latest-per-context rollup, non-bookkeeping
  FAILURE/TIMED_OUT) + the existing failed-run link line. The parked PR leaves
  `validate-armed`'s FIFO (query excludes the label) → **no third dispatch** (AC1/AC3).

{"content":"# gh-832 — Red validation verdicts loop forever — no convergence

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On an approved head whose validation CI repeatedly concludes red, the SM
machine never converges: it cycles `approved_queue → validating → approved_queue`
forever (live fa PR #1453: 12 dispatch→red→unarm→rearm cycles, 5 consecutive
FAILUREs, window idle 3.5h, no `validation_failed` park, no escalation). The stuck
quarantine PR fa #1470 could not merge because the loop burned the whole window.

**Root cause**: `fail_validation` (js/smAgent.js) has no convergence counter that
PARKS a red PR:

- **Machine-authored PRs are never parked.** The fail path only parks `validation_failed`
  for GUEST PRs (gh-757). A machine PR's only terminal guards are (a) the empty-lap
  cap (withholds the rework arm at the 3rd red on the same head) and (b) the
  `redHeadSkip` arm-side skip at `redHeadCap` (default 3) recorded 🔴 marker reds.
  Both are **per-head-SHA counters**, so every head refresh (silent-update/rework
  WIP push) resets them to zero — a fleet-wide flake riding in main makes every new
  head go red exactly once, so the caps never accumulate.
- **The terminal state is silent.** Even when the caps do fire, the outcome is a
  log line (`🚫 head already went red 3× — re-arm blocked`) — no park, no comment,
  no escalation. The red PR keeps matching `validate-armed` every tick; with the
  verdict probe momentarily non-failure (registration lag / cancelled interleave
  bypassing `deferRedHead`), the arm re-dispatches — the observed 12-cycle loop.

**Impact**: Any repeated red validation verdict on an approved head (fleet-wide
flake wave, broken main) burns CI and the single validation mutex indefinitely,
idles the merge window, and blocks unrelated recovery PRs (the quarantine PR itself
was stuck in the same loop). fa #1453 (12 cycles), fa #1470 (quarantine, stuck).

**Fix approach**: Convergence counter derived from the head's own dispatched run
history — the durable per-head record already fetched by the fail path:

- `streakFromRuns(runs, headSha)`: trailing count of consecutive concluded red
  verdict runs (`workflow_dispatch`, same head SHA, newest-first; `success` breaks
  the streak — AC2 green reset; `cancelled` is skipped per gh-755 — never a
  verdict; any other conclusion counts as red). A head change resets by
  construction (SHA-filtered — AC2 head-change reset).
- At `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (default **2**) consecutive reds on the unchanged
  head, the fail path PARKS the PR: `validation_failed` label + the report names

{"content":"# gh-832 — Red validation verdicts loop forever — no convergence

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On an approved head whose validation CI repeatedly concludes red, the SM
machine never converges: it cycles `approved_queue → validating → approved_queue`
forever (live fa PR #1453: 12 dispatch→red→unarm→rearm cycles, 5 consecutive
FAILUREs, window idle 3.5h, no `validation_failed` park, no escalation). The stuck
quarantine PR fa #1470 could not merge because the loop burned the whole window.

**Root cause**: `fail_validation` (js/smAgent.js) has no convergence counter that
PARKS a red PR:

- **Machine-authored PRs are never parked.** The fail path only parks `validation_failed`
  for GUEST PRs (gh-757). A machine PR's only terminal guards are (a) the empty-lap
  cap (withholds the rework arm at the 3rd red on the same head) and (b) the
  `redHeadSkip` arm-side skip at `redHeadCap` (default 3) recorded 🔴 marker reds.
  Both are **per-head-SHA counters**, so every head refresh (silent-update/rework
  WIP push) resets them to zero — a fleet-wide flake riding in main makes every new
  head go red exactly once, so the caps never accumulate.
- **The terminal state is silent.** Even when the caps do fire, the outcome is a
  log line (`🚫 head already went red 3× — re-arm blocked`) — no park, no comment,
  no escalation. The red PR keeps matching `validate-armed` every tick; with the
  verdict probe momentarily non-failure (registration lag / cancelled interleave
  bypassing `deferRedHead`), the arm re-dispatches — the observed 12-cycle loop.

**Impact**: Any repeated red validation verdict on an approved head (fleet-wide
flake wave, broken main) burns CI and the single validation mutex indefinitely,
idles the merge window, and blocks unrelated recovery PRs (the quarantine PR itself
was stuck in the same loop). fa #1453 (12 cycles), fa #1470 (quarantine, stuck).

**Fix approach**: Convergence counter derived from the head's own dispatched run
history — the durable per-head record already fetched by the fail path:

- `streakFromRuns(runs, headSha)`: trailing count of consecutive concluded red
  verdict runs (`workflow_dispatch`, same head SHA, newest-first; `success` breaks
  the streak — AC2 green reset; `cancelled` is skipped per gh-755 — never a
  verdict; any other conclusion counts as red). A head change resets by
  construction (SHA-filtered — AC2 head-change reset).
- At `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (default **2**) consecutive reds on the unchanged
  head, the fail path PARKS the PR: `validation_failed` label + the report names
  the failing check job(s) (latest-per-context rollup, non-bookkeeping
  FAILURE/TIMED_OUT) + the existing failed-run link line. The parked PR leaves
  `validate-armed`'s FIFO (query excludes the label) → **no third dispatch** (AC1/AC3).
- Machine PRs keep the rework arm exactly as today (non-goal: red→rework routing
  unchanged) — the parked machine PR exits the park through the existing gh-750
  machine self-clear / #633 RESET probes once the rework push moves the head.
- One shared `github_list_workflow_runs` fetch feeds both the existing
  failed-run link line and the streak (no extra API pressure).
- Escape hatch: `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (0/false disables the park; the
  red-head marker recording and the 3-red arm-side skip are untouched).

{"content":"# gh-832 — Red validation verdicts loop forever — no convergence

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On an approved head whose validation CI repeatedly concludes red, the SM
machine never converges: it cycles `approved_queue → validating → approved_queue`
forever (live fa PR #1453: 12 dispatch→red→unarm→rearm cycles, 5 consecutive
FAILUREs, window idle 3.5h, no `validation_failed` park, no escalation). The stuck
quarantine PR fa #1470 could not merge because the loop burned the whole window.

**Root cause**: `fail_validation` (js/smAgent.js) has no convergence counter that
PARKS a red PR:

- **Machine-authored PRs are never parked.** The fail path only parks `validation_failed`
  for GUEST PRs (gh-757). A machine PR's only terminal guards are (a) the empty-lap
  cap (withholds the rework arm at the 3rd red on the same head) and (b) the
  `redHeadSkip` arm-side skip at `redHeadCap` (default 3) recorded 🔴 marker reds.
  Both are **per-head-SHA counters**, so every head refresh (silent-update/rework
  WIP push) resets them to zero — a fleet-wide flake riding in main makes every new
  head go red exactly once, so the caps never accumulate.
- **The terminal state is silent.** Even when the caps do fire, the outcome is a
  log line (`🚫 head already went red 3× — re-arm blocked`) — no park, no comment,
  no escalation. The red PR keeps matching `validate-armed` every tick; with the
  verdict probe momentarily non-failure (registration lag / cancelled interleave
  bypassing `deferRedHead`), the arm re-dispatches — the observed 12-cycle loop.

**Impact**: Any repeated red validation verdict on an approved head (fleet-wide
flake wave, broken main) burns CI and the single validation mutex indefinitely,
idles the merge window, and blocks unrelated recovery PRs (the quarantine PR itself
was stuck in the same loop). fa #1453 (12 cycles), fa #1470 (quarantine, stuck).

**Fix approach**: Convergence counter derived from the head's own dispatched run
history — the durable per-head record already fetched by the fail path:

- `streakFromRuns(runs, headSha)`: trailing count of consecutive concluded red
  verdict runs (`workflow_dispatch`, same head SHA, newest-first; `success` breaks
  the streak — AC2 green reset; `cancelled` is skipped per gh-755 — never a
  verdict; any other conclusion counts as red). A head change resets by
  construction (SHA-filtered — AC2 head-change reset).
- At `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (default **2**) consecutive reds on the unchanged
  head, the fail path PARKS the PR: `validation_failed` label + the report names
  the failing check job(s) (latest-per-context rollup, non-bookkeeping
  FAILURE/TIMED_OUT) + the existing failed-run link line. The parked PR leaves
  `validate-armed`'s FIFO (query excludes the label) → **no third dispatch** (AC1/AC3).
- Machine PRs keep the rework arm exactly as today (non-goal: red→rework routing
  unchanged) — the parked machine PR exits the park through the existing gh-750
  machine self-clear / #633 RESET probes once the rework push moves the head.
- One shared `github_list_workflow_runs` fetch feeds both the existing
  failed-run link line and the streak (no extra API pressure).
- Escape hatch: `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (0/false disables the park; the
  red-head marker recording and the 3-red arm-side skip are untouched).

{"content":"# gh-832 — Red validation verdicts loop forever — no convergence

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On an approved head whose validation CI repeatedly concludes red, the SM
machine never converges: it cycles `approved_queue → validating → approved_queue`
forever (live fa PR #1453: 12 dispatch→red→unarm→rearm cycles, 5 consecutive
FAILUREs, window idle 3.5h, no `validation_failed` park, no escalation). The stuck
quarantine PR fa #1470 could not merge because the loop burned the whole window.

**Root cause**: `fail_validation` (js/smAgent.js) has no convergence counter that
PARKS a red PR:

- **Machine-authored PRs are never parked.** The fail path only parks `validation_failed`
  for GUEST PRs (gh-757). A machine PR's only terminal guards are (a) the empty-lap
  cap (withholds the rework arm at the 3rd red on the same head) and (b) the
  `redHeadSkip` arm-side skip at `redHeadCap` (default 3) recorded 🔴 marker reds.
  Both are **per-head-SHA counters**, so every head refresh (silent-update/rework
  WIP push) resets them to zero — a fleet-wide flake riding in main makes every new
  head go red exactly once, so the caps never accumulate.
- **The terminal state is silent.** Even when the caps do fire, the outcome is a
  log line (`🚫 head already went red 3× — re-arm blocked`) — no park, no comment,
  no escalation. The red PR keeps matching `validate-armed` every tick; with the
  verdict probe momentarily non-failure (registration lag / cancelled interleave
  bypassing `deferRedHead`), the arm re-dispatches — the observed 12-cycle loop.

**Impact**: Any repeated red validation verdict on an approved head (fleet-wide
flake wave, broken main) burns CI and the single validation mutex indefinitely,
idles the merge window, and blocks unrelated recovery PRs (the quarantine PR itself
was stuck in the same loop). fa #1453 (12 cycles), fa #1470 (quarantine, stuck).

**Fix approach**: Convergence counter derived from the head's own dispatched run
history — the durable per-head record already fetched by the fail path:

- `streakFromRuns(runs, headSha)`: trailing count of consecutive concluded red
  verdict runs (`workflow_dispatch`, same head SHA, newest-first; `success` breaks
  the streak — AC2 green reset; `cancelled` is skipped per gh-755 — never a
  verdict; any other conclusion counts as red). A head change resets by
  construction (SHA-filtered — AC2 head-change reset).
- At `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (default **2**) consecutive reds on the unchanged
  head, the fail path PARKS the PR: `validation_failed` label + the report names
  the failing check job(s) (latest-per-context rollup, non-bookkeeping
  FAILURE/TIMED_OUT) + the existing failed-run link line. The parked PR leaves
  `validate-armed`'s FIFO (query excludes the label) → **no third dispatch** (AC1/AC3).
- Machine PRs keep the rework arm exactly as today (non-goal: red→rework routing
  unchanged) — the parked machine PR exits the park through the existing gh-750
  machine self-clear / #633 RESET probes once the rework push moves the head.
- One shared `github_list_workflow_runs` fetch feeds both the existing
  failed-run link line and the streak (no extra API pressure).
- Escape hatch: `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (0/false disables the park; the
  red-head marker recording and the 3-red arm-side skip are untouched).

{"content":"# gh-832 — Red validation verdicts loop forever — no convergence

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On an approved head whose validation CI repeatedly concludes red, the SM
machine never converges: it cycles `approved_queue → validating → approved_queue`
forever (live fa PR #1453: 12 dispatch→red→unarm→rearm cycles, 5 consecutive
FAILUREs, window idle 3.5h, no `validation_failed` park, no escalation). The stuck
quarantine PR fa #1470 could not merge because the loop burned the whole window.

**Root cause**: `fail_validation` (js/smAgent.js) has no convergence counter that
PARKS a red PR:

- **Machine-authored PRs are never parked.** The fail path only parks `validation_failed`
  for GUEST PRs (gh-757). A machine PR's only terminal guards are (a) the empty-lap
  cap (withholds the rework arm at the 3rd red on the same head) and (b) the
  `redHeadSkip` arm-side skip at `redHeadCap` (default 3) recorded 🔴 marker reds.
  Both are **per-head-SHA counters**, so every head refresh (silent-update/rework
  WIP push) resets them to zero — a fleet-wide flake riding in main makes every new
  head go red exactly once, so the caps never accumulate.
- **The terminal state is silent.** Even when the caps do fire, the outcome is a
  log line (`🚫 head already went red 3× — re-arm blocked`) — no park, no comment,
  no escalation. The red PR keeps matching `validate-armed` every tick; with the
  verdict probe momentarily non-failure (registration lag / cancelled interleave
  bypassing `deferRedHead`), the arm re-dispatches — the observed 12-cycle loop.

**Impact**: Any repeated red validation verdict on an approved head (fleet-wide
flake wave, broken main) burns CI and the single validation mutex indefinitely,
idles the merge window, and blocks unrelated recovery PRs (the quarantine PR itself
was stuck in the same loop). fa #1453 (12 cycles), fa #1470 (quarantine, stuck).

**Fix approach**: Convergence counter derived from the head's own dispatched run
history — the durable per-head record already fetched by the fail path:

- `streakFromRuns(runs, headSha)`: trailing count of consecutive concluded red
  verdict runs (`workflow_dispatch`, same head SHA, newest-first; `success` breaks
  the streak — AC2 green reset; `cancelled` is skipped per gh-755 — never a
  verdict; any other conclusion counts as red). A head change resets by
  construction (SHA-filtered — AC2 head-change reset).
- At `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (default **2**) consecutive reds on the unchanged
  head, the fail path PARKS the PR: `validation_failed` label + the report names
  the failing check job(s) (latest-per-context rollup, non-bookkeeping
  FAILURE/TIMED_OUT) + the existing failed-run link line. The parked PR leaves
  `validate-armed`'s FIFO (query excludes the label) → **no third dispatch** (AC1/AC3).
- Machine PRs keep the rework arm exactly as today (non-goal: red→rework routing
  unchanged) — the parked machine PR exits the park through the existing gh-750
  machine self-clear / #633 RESET probes once the rework push moves the head.
- One shared `github_list_workflow_runs` fetch feeds both the existing
  failed-run link line and the streak (no extra API pressure).
- Escape hatch: `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (0/false disables the park; the
  red-head marker recording and the 3-red arm-side skip are untouched).

{"content":"# gh-832 — Red validation verdicts loop forever — no convergence

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On an approved head whose validation CI repeatedly concludes red, the SM
machine never converges: it cycles `approved_queue → validating → approved_queue`
forever (live fa PR #1453: 12 dispatch→red→unarm→rearm cycles, 5 consecutive
FAILUREs, window idle 3.5h, no `validation_failed` park, no escalation). The stuck
quarantine PR fa #1470 could not merge because the loop burned the whole window.

**Root cause**: `fail_validation` (js/smAgent.js) has no convergence counter that
PARKS a red PR:

- **Machine-authored PRs are never parked.** The fail path only parks `validation_failed`
  for GUEST PRs (gh-757). A machine PR's only terminal guards are (a) the empty-lap
  cap (withholds the rework arm at the 3rd red on the same head) and (b) the
  `redHeadSkip` arm-side skip at `redHeadCap` (default 3) recorded 🔴 marker reds.
  Both are **per-head-SHA counters**, so every head refresh (silent-update/rework
  WIP push) resets them to zero — a fleet-wide flake riding in main makes every new
  head go red exactly once, so the caps never accumulate.
- **The terminal state is silent.** Even when the caps do fire, the outcome is a
  log line (`🚫 head already went red 3× — re-arm blocked`) — no park, no comment,
  no escalation. The red PR keeps matching `validate-armed` every tick; with the
  verdict probe momentarily non-failure (registration lag / cancelled interleave
  bypassing `deferRedHead`), the arm re-dispatches — the observed 12-cycle loop.

**Impact**: Any repeated red validation verdict on an approved head (fleet-wide
flake wave, broken main) burns CI and the single validation mutex indefinitely,
idles the merge window, and blocks unrelated recovery PRs (the quarantine PR itself
was stuck in the same loop). fa #1453 (12 cycles), fa #1470 (quarantine, stuck).

**Fix approach**: Convergence counter derived from the head's own dispatched run
history — the durable per-head record already fetched by the fail path:

- `streakFromRuns(runs, headSha)`: trailing count of consecutive concluded red
  verdict runs (`workflow_dispatch`, same head SHA, newest-first; `success` breaks
  the streak — AC2 green reset; `cancelled` is skipped per gh-755 — never a
  verdict; any other conclusion counts as red). A head change resets by
  construction (SHA-filtered — AC2 head-change reset).
- At `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (default **2**) consecutive reds on the unchanged
  head, the fail path PARKS the PR: `validation_failed` label + the report names
  the failing check job(s) (latest-per-context rollup, non-bookkeeping
  FAILURE/TIMED_OUT) + the existing failed-run link line. The parked PR leaves
  `validate-armed`'s FIFO (query excludes the label) → **no third dispatch** (AC1/AC3).
- Machine PRs keep the rework arm exactly as today (non-goal: red→rework routing
  unchanged) — the parked machine PR exits the park through the existing gh-750
  machine self-clear / #633 RESET probes once the rework push moves the head.
- One shared `github_list_workflow_runs` fetch feeds both the existing
  failed-run link line and the streak (no extra API pressure).
- Escape hatch: `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (0/false disables the park; the
  red-head marker recording and the 3-red arm-side skip are untouched).
","path":"outputs/rca.md"}

{"content":"# gh-832 — Red validation verdicts loop forever — no convergence

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On an approved head whose validation CI repeatedly concludes red, the SM
machine never converges: it cycles `approved_queue → validating → approved_queue`
forever (live fa PR #1453: 12 dispatch→red→unarm→rearm cycles, 5 consecutive
FAILUREs, window idle 3.5h, no `validation_failed` park, no escalation). The stuck
quarantine PR fa #1470 could not merge because the loop burned the whole window.

**Root cause**: `fail_validation` (js/smAgent.js) has no convergence counter that
PARKS a red PR:

- **Machine-authored PRs are never parked.** The fail path only parks `validation_failed`
  for GUEST PRs (gh-757). A machine PR's only terminal guards are (a) the empty-lap
  cap (withholds the rework arm at the 3rd red on the same head) and (b) the
  `redHeadSkip` arm-side skip at `redHeadCap` (default 3) recorded 🔴 marker reds.
  Both are **per-head-SHA counters**, so every head refresh (silent-update/rework
  WIP push) resets them to zero — a fleet-wide flake riding in main makes every new
  head go red exactly once, so the caps never accumulate.
- **The terminal state is silent.** Even when the caps do fire, the outcome is a
  log line (`🚫 head already went red 3× — re-arm blocked`) — no park, no comment,
  no escalation. The red PR keeps matching `validate-armed` every tick; with the
  verdict probe momentarily non-failure (registration lag / cancelled interleave
  bypassing `deferRedHead`), the arm re-dispatches — the observed 12-cycle loop.

**Impact**: Any repeated red validation verdict on an approved head (fleet-wide
flake wave, broken main) burns CI and the single validation mutex indefinitely,
idles the merge window, and blocks unrelated recovery PRs (the quarantine PR itself
was stuck in the same loop). fa #1453 (12 cycles), fa #1470 (quarantine, stuck).

**Fix approach**: Convergence counter derived from the head's own dispatched run
history — the durable per-head record already fetched by the fail path:

- `streakFromRuns(runs, headSha)`: trailing count of consecutive concluded red
  verdict runs (`workflow_dispatch`, same head SHA, newest-first; `success` breaks
  the streak — AC2 green reset; `cancelled` is skipped per gh-755 — never a
  verdict; any other conclusion counts as red). A head change resets by
  construction (SHA-filtered — AC2 head-change reset).
- At `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (default **2**) consecutive reds on the unchanged
  head, the fail path PARKS the PR: `validation_failed` label + the report names
  the failing check job(s) (latest-per-context rollup, non-bookkeeping
  FAILURE/TIMED_OUT) + the existing failed-run link line. The parked PR leaves
  `validate-armed`'s FIFO (query excludes the label) → **no third dispatch** (AC1/AC3).
- Machine PRs keep the rework arm exactly as today (non-goal: red→rework routing
  unchanged) — the parked machine PR exits the park through the existing gh-750
  machine self-clear / #633 RESET probes once the rework push moves the head.
- One shared `github_list_workflow_runs` fetch feeds both the existing
  failed-run link line and the streak (no extra API pressure).
- Escape hatch: `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (0/false disables the park; the
  red-head marker recording and the 3-red arm-side skip are untouched).

{"content":"# gh-832 — Red validation verdicts loop forever — no convergence

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On an approved head whose validation CI repeatedly concludes red, the SM
machine never converges: it cycles `approved_queue → validating → approved_queue`
forever (live fa PR #1453: 12 dispatch→red→unarm→rearm cycles, 5 consecutive
FAILUREs, window idle 3.5h, no `validation_failed` park, no escalation). The stuck
quarantine PR fa #1470 could not merge because the loop burned the whole window.

**Root cause**: `fail_validation` (js/smAgent.js) has no convergence counter that
PARKS a red PR:

- **Machine-authored PRs are never parked.** The fail path only parks `validation_failed`
  for GUEST PRs (gh-757). A machine PR's only terminal guards are (a) the empty-lap
  cap (withholds the rework arm at the 3rd red on the same head) and (b) the
  `redHeadSkip` arm-side skip at `redHeadCap` (default 3) recorded 🔴 marker reds.
  Both are **per-head-SHA counters**, so every head refresh (silent-update/rework
  WIP push) resets them to zero — a fleet-wide flake riding in main makes every new
  head go red exactly once, so the caps never accumulate.
- **The terminal state is silent.** Even when the caps do fire, the outcome is a
  log line (`🚫 head already went red 3× — re-arm blocked`) — no park, no comment,
  no escalation. The red PR keeps matching `validate-armed` every tick; with the
  verdict probe momentarily non-failure (registration lag / cancelled interleave
  bypassing `deferRedHead`), the arm re-dispatches — the observed 12-cycle loop.

**Impact**: Any repeated red validation verdict on an approved head (fleet-wide
flake wave, broken main) burns CI and the single validation mutex indefinitely,
idles the merge window, and blocks unrelated recovery PRs (the quarantine PR itself
was stuck in the same loop). fa #1453 (12 cycles), fa #1470 (quarantine, stuck).

**Fix approach**: Convergence counter derived from the head's own dispatched run
history — the durable per-head record already fetched by the fail path:

- `streakFromRuns(runs, headSha)`: trailing count of consecutive concluded red
  verdict runs (`workflow_dispatch`, same head SHA, newest-first; `success` breaks
  the streak — AC2 green reset; `cancelled` is skipped per gh-755 — never a
  verdict; any other conclusion counts as red). A head change resets by
  construction (SHA-filtered — AC2 head-change reset).
- At `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (default **2**) consecutive reds on the unchanged
  head, the fail path PARKS the PR: `validation_failed` label + the report names
  the failing check job(s) (latest-per-context rollup, non-bookkeeping
  FAILURE/TIMED_OUT) + the existing failed-run link line. The parked PR leaves
  `validate-armed`'s FIFO (query excludes the label) → **no third dispatch** (AC1/AC3).
- Machine PRs keep the rework arm exactly as today (non-goal: red→rework routing
  unchanged) — the parked machine PR exits the park through the existing gh-750
  machine self-clear / #633 RESET probes once the rework push moves the head.
- One shared `github_list_workflow_runs` fetch feeds both the existing
  failed-run link line and the streak (no extra API pressure).
- Escape hatch: `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (0/false disables the park; the
  red-head marker recording and the 3-red arm-side skip are untouched).

{"content":"# gh-832 — Red validation verdicts loop forever — no convergence

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On an approved head whose validation CI repeatedly concludes red, the SM
machine never converges: it cycles `approved_queue → validating → approved_queue`
forever (live fa PR #1453: 12 dispatch→red→unarm→rearm cycles, 5 consecutive
FAILUREs, window idle 3.5h, no `validation_failed` park, no escalation). The stuck
quarantine PR fa #1470 could not merge because the loop burned the whole window.

**Root cause**: `fail_validation` (js/smAgent.js) has no convergence counter that
PARKS a red PR:

- **Machine-authored PRs are never parked.** The fail path only parks `validation_failed`
  for GUEST PRs (gh-757). A machine PR's only terminal guards are (a) the empty-lap
  cap (withholds the rework arm at the 3rd red on the same head) and (b) the
  `redHeadSkip` arm-side skip at `redHeadCap` (default 3) recorded 🔴 marker reds.
  Both are **per-head-SHA counters**, so every head refresh (silent-update/rework
  WIP push) resets them to zero — a fleet-wide flake riding in main makes every new
  head go red exactly once, so the caps never accumulate.
- **The terminal state is silent.** Even when the caps do fire, the outcome is a
  log line (`🚫 head already went red 3× — re-arm blocked`) — no park, no comment,
  no escalation. The red PR keeps matching `validate-armed` every tick; with the
  verdict probe momentarily non-failure (registration lag / cancelled interleave
  bypassing `deferRedHead`), the arm re-dispatches — the observed 12-cycle loop.

**Impact**: Any repeated red validation verdict on an approved head (fleet-wide
flake wave, broken main) burns CI and the single validation mutex indefinitely,
idles the merge window, and blocks unrelated recovery PRs (the quarantine PR itself
was stuck in the same loop). fa #1453 (12 cycles), fa #1470 (quarantine, stuck).

**Fix approach**: Convergence counter derived from the head's own dispatched run
history — the durable per-head record already fetched by the fail path:

- `streakFromRuns(runs, headSha)`: trailing count of consecutive concluded red
  verdict runs (`workflow_dispatch`, same head SHA, newest-first; `success` breaks
  the streak — AC2 green reset; `cancelled` is skipped per gh-755 — never a
  verdict; any other conclusion counts as red). A head change resets by
  construction (SHA-filtered — AC2 head-change reset).
- At `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (default **2**) consecutive reds on the unchanged
  head, the fail path PARKS the PR: `validation_failed` label + the report names
  the failing check job(s) (latest-per-context rollup, non-bookkeeping
  FAILURE/TIMED_OUT) + the existing failed-run link line. The parked PR leaves
  `validate-armed`'s FIFO (query excludes the label) → **no third dispatch** (AC1/AC3).
- Machine PRs keep the rework arm exactly as today (non-goal: red→rework routing
  unchanged) — the parked machine PR exits the park through the existing gh-750
  machine self-clear / #633 RESET probes once the rework push moves the head.
- One shared `github_list_workflow_runs` fetch feeds both the existing
  failed-run link line and the streak (no extra API pressure).
- Escape hatch: `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (0/false disables the park; the
  red-head marker recording and the 3-red arm-side skip are untouched).

{"content":"# gh-832 — Red validation verdicts loop forever — no convergence

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On an approved head whose validation CI repeatedly concludes red, the SM
machine never converges: it cycles `approved_queue → validating → approved_queue`
forever (live fa PR #1453: 12 dispatch→red→unarm→rearm cycles, 5 consecutive
FAILUREs, window idle 3.5h, no `validation_failed` park, no escalation). The stuck
quarantine PR fa #1470 could not merge because the loop burned the whole window.

**Root cause**: `fail_validation` (js/smAgent.js) has no convergence counter that
PARKS a red PR:

- **Machine-authored PRs are never parked.** The fail path only parks `validation_failed`
  for GUEST PRs (gh-757). A machine PR's only terminal guards are (a) the empty-lap
  cap (withholds the rework arm at the 3rd red on the same head) and (b) the
  `redHeadSkip` arm-side skip at `redHeadCap` (default 3) recorded 🔴 marker reds.
  Both are **per-head-SHA counters**, so every head refresh (silent-update/rework
  WIP push) resets them to zero — a fleet-wide flake riding in main makes every new
  head go red exactly once, so the caps never accumulate.
- **The terminal state is silent.** Even when the caps do fire, the outcome is a
  log line (`🚫 head already went red 3× — re-arm blocked`) — no park, no comment,
  no escalation. The red PR keeps matching `validate-armed` every tick; with the
  verdict probe momentarily non-failure (registration lag / cancelled interleave
  bypassing `deferRedHead`), the arm re-dispatches — the observed 12-cycle loop.

**Impact**: Any repeated red validation verdict on an approved head (fleet-wide
flake wave, broken main) burns CI and the single validation mutex indefinitely,
idles the merge window, and blocks unrelated recovery PRs (the quarantine PR itself
was stuck in the same loop). fa #1453 (12 cycles), fa #1470 (quarantine, stuck).

**Fix approach**: Convergence counter derived from the head's own dispatched run
history — the durable per-head record already fetched by the fail path:

- `streakFromRuns(runs, headSha)`: trailing count of consecutive concluded red
  verdict runs (`workflow_dispatch`, same head SHA, newest-first; `success` breaks
  the streak — AC2 green reset; `cancelled` is skipped per gh-755 — never a
  verdict; any other conclusion counts as red). A head change resets by
  construction (SHA-filtered — AC2 head-change reset).
- At `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (default **2**) consecutive reds on the unchanged
  head, the fail path PARKS the PR: `validation_failed` label + the report names
  the failing check job(s) (latest-per-context rollup, non-bookkeeping
  FAILURE/TIMED_OUT) + the existing failed-run link line. The parked PR leaves
  `validate-armed`'s FIFO (query excludes the label) → **no third dispatch** (AC1/AC3).
- Machine PRs keep the rework arm exactly as today (non-goal: red→rework routing
  unchanged) — the parked machine PR exits the park through the existing gh-750
