{"content":"# gh-832 — Red validation verdicts loop forever — no convergence

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On an approved head whose validation CI repeatedly concludes red, the SM
machine never converges: it cycles `approved_queue → validating → approved_queue`
forever (live fa PR #1453: 12 dispatch→red→unarm→rearm cycles, 5 consecutive
FAILUREs, window idle 3.5h, no `validation_failed` park, no escalation). The stuck
quarantine PR fa #1470 could not merge because the loop burned the whole window.

**Root cause**: `fail_validation` (js/smAgent.js) has no convergence counter that
PARKS a red PR:

- **Machine-authored PRs are never parked.** The fail path only parks `validation_failed`
  for GUEST PRs (gh-757). A machine PR's only terminal guards are (a) the empty-lap
  cap (withholds the rework arm at the 3rd red on the same head) and (b) the
  `redHeadSkip` arm-side skip at `redHeadCap` (default 3) recorded 🔴 marker reds.
  Both are **per-head-SHA counters**, so every head refresh (silent-update/rework
  WIP push) resets them to zero — a fleet-wide flake riding in main makes every new
  head go red exactly once, so the caps never accumulate.
- **The terminal state is silent.** Even when the caps do fire, the outcome is a
  log line (`🚫 head already went red 3× — re-arm blocked`) — no park, no comment,
  no escalation. The red PR keeps matching `validate-armed` every tick; with the
  verdict probe momentarily non-failure (registration lag / cancelled interleave
  bypassing `deferRedHead`), the arm re-dispatches — the observed 12-cycle loop.

**Impact**: Any repeated red validation verdict on an approved head (fleet-wide
flake wave, broken main) burns CI and the single validation mutex indefinitely,
idles the merge window, and blocks unrelated recovery PRs (the quarantine PR itself
was stuck in the same loop). fa #1453 (12 cycles), fa #1470 (quarantine, stuck).

**Fix approach**: Convergence counter derived from the head's own dispatched run
history — the durable per-head record already fetched by the fail path:

- `streakFromRuns(runs, headSha)`: trailing count of consecutive concluded red
  verdict runs (`workflow_dispatch`, same head SHA, newest-first; `success` breaks
  the streak — AC2 green reset; `cancelled` is skipped per gh-755 — never a
  verdict; any other conclusion counts as red). A head change resets by
  construction (SHA-filtered — AC2 head-change reset).
- At `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (default **2**) consecutive reds on the unchanged
  head, the fail path PARKS the PR: `validation_failed` label + the report names
  the failing check job(s) (latest-per-context rollup, non-bookkeeping
  FAILURE/TIMED_OUT) + the existing failed-run link line. The parked PR leaves
  `validate-armed`'s FIFO (query excludes the label) → **no third dispatch** (AC1/AC3).
- Machine PRs keep the rework arm exactly as today (non-goal: red→rework routing
  unchanged) — the parked machine PR exits the park through the existing gh-750
  machine self-clear / #633 RESET probes once the rework push moves the head.
- One shared `github_list_workflow_runs` fetch feeds both the existing
  failed-run link line and the streak (no extra API pressure).
- Escape hatch: `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (0/false disables the park; the
  red-head marker recording and the 3-red arm-side skip are untouched).

{"content":"# gh-832 — Red validation verdicts loop forever — no convergence

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On an approved head whose validation CI repeatedly concludes red, the SM
machine never converges: it cycles `approved_queue → validating → approved_queue`
forever (live fa PR #1453: 12 dispatch→red→unarm→rearm cycles, 5 consecutive
FAILUREs, window idle 3.5h, no `validation_failed` park, no escalation). The stuck
quarantine PR fa #1470 could not merge because the loop burned the whole window.

**Root cause**: `fail_validation` (js/smAgent.js) has no convergence counter that
PARKS a red PR:

- **Machine-authored PRs are never parked.** The fail path only parks `validation_failed`
  for GUEST PRs (gh-757). A machine PR's only terminal guards are (a) the empty-lap
  cap (withholds the rework arm at the 3rd red on the same head) and (b) the
  `redHeadSkip` arm-side skip at `redHeadCap` (default 3) recorded 🔴 marker reds.
  Both are **per-head-SHA counters**, so every head refresh (silent-update/rework
  WIP push) resets them to zero — a fleet-wide flake riding in main makes every new
  head go red exactly once, so the caps never accumulate.
- **The terminal state is silent.** Even when the caps do fire, the outcome is a
  log line (`🚫 head already went red 3× — re-arm blocked`) — no park, no comment,
  no escalation. The red PR keeps matching `validate-armed` every tick; with the
  verdict probe momentarily non-failure (registration lag / cancelled interleave
  bypassing `deferRedHead`), the arm re-dispatches — the observed 12-cycle loop.

**Impact**: Any repeated red validation verdict on an approved head (fleet-wide
flake wave, broken main) burns CI and the single validation mutex indefinitely,
idles the merge window, and blocks unrelated recovery PRs (the quarantine PR itself
was stuck in the same loop). fa #1453 (12 cycles), fa #1470 (quarantine, stuck).

**Fix approach**: Convergence counter derived from the head's own dispatched run
history — the durable per-head record already fetched by the fail path:

- `streakFromRuns(runs, headSha)`: trailing count of consecutive concluded red
  verdict runs (`workflow_dispatch`, same head SHA, newest-first; `success` breaks
  the streak — AC2 green reset; `cancelled` is skipped per gh-755 — never a
  verdict; any other conclusion counts as red). A head change resets by
  construction (SHA-filtered — AC2 head-change reset).
- At `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (default **2**) consecutive reds on the unchanged
  head, the fail path PARKS the PR: `validation_failed` label + the report names
  the failing check job(s) (latest-per-context rollup, non-bookkeeping
  FAILURE/TIMED_OUT) + the existing failed-run link line. The parked PR leaves
  `validate-armed`'s FIFO (query excludes the label) → **no third dispatch** (AC1/AC3).
- Machine PRs keep the rework arm exactly as today (non-goal: red→rework routing
  unchanged) — the parked machine PR exits the park through the existing gh-750
  machine self-clear / #633 RESET probes once the rework push moves the head.
- One shared `github_list_workflow_runs` fetch feeds both the existing
  failed-run link line and the streak (no extra API pressure).
- Escape hatch: `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (0/false disables the park; the
  red-head marker recording and the 3-red arm-side skip are untouched).

{"content":"# gh-832 — Red validation verdicts loop forever — no convergence

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: On an approved head whose validation CI repeatedly concludes red, the SM
machine never converges: it cycles `approved_queue → validating → approved_queue`
forever (live fa PR #1453: 12 dispatch→red→unarm→rearm cycles, 5 consecutive
FAILUREs, window idle 3.5h, no `validation_failed` park, no escalation). The stuck
quarantine PR fa #1470 could not merge because the loop burned the whole window.

**Root cause**: `fail_validation` (js/smAgent.js) has no convergence counter that
PARKS a red PR:

- **Machine-authored PRs are never parked.** The fail path only parks `validation_failed`
  for GUEST PRs (gh-757). A machine PR's only terminal guards are (a) the empty-lap
  cap (withholds the rework arm at the 3rd red on the same head) and (b) the
  `redHeadSkip` arm-side skip at `redHeadCap` (default 3) recorded 🔴 marker reds.
  Both are **per-head-SHA counters**, so every head refresh (silent-update/rework
  WIP push) resets them to zero — a fleet-wide flake riding in main makes every new
  head go red exactly once, so the caps never accumulate.
- **The terminal state is silent.** Even when the caps do fire, the outcome is a
  log line (`🚫 head already went red 3× — re-arm blocked`) — no park, no comment,
  no escalation. The red PR keeps matching `validate-armed` every tick; with the
  verdict probe momentarily non-failure (registration lag / cancelled interleave
  bypassing `deferRedHead`), the arm re-dispatches — the observed 12-cycle loop.

**Impact**: Any repeated red validation verdict on an approved head (fleet-wide
flake wave, broken main) burns CI and the single validation mutex indefinitely,
idles the merge window, and blocks unrelated recovery PRs (the quarantine PR itself
was stuck in the same loop). fa #1453 (12 cycles), fa #1470 (quarantine, stuck).

**Fix approach**: Convergence counter derived from the head's own dispatched run
history — the durable per-head record already fetched by the fail path:

- `streakFromRuns(runs, headSha)`: trailing count of consecutive concluded red
  verdict runs (`workflow_dispatch`, same head SHA, newest-first; `success` breaks
  the streak — AC2 green reset; `cancelled` is skipped per gh-755 — never a
  verdict; any other conclusion counts as red). A head change resets by
  construction (SHA-filtered — AC2 head-change reset).
- At `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (default **2**) consecutive reds on the unchanged
  head, the fail path PARKS the PR: `validation_failed` label + the report names
  the failing check job(s) (latest-per-context rollup, non-bookkeeping
  FAILURE/TIMED_OUT) + the existing failed-run link line. The parked PR leaves
  `validate-armed`'s FIFO (query excludes the label) → **no third dispatch** (AC1/AC3).
- Machine PRs keep the rework arm exactly as today (non-goal: red→rework routing
  unchanged) — the parked machine PR exits the park through the existing gh-750
  machine self-clear / #633 RESET probes once the rework push moves the head.
- One shared `github_list_workflow_runs` fetch feeds both the existing
  failed-run link line and the streak (no extra API pressure).
- Escape hatch: `jobParams.redHeadParkCap` (0/false disables the park; the
  red-head marker recording and the 3-red arm-side skip are untouched).

      - items: prItem(1453, {labels: [pr_approved, ai_validating], author: 'ai-teammate', headSha: 'sha1453', branch: 'ai/gh-1453'})
      - pr: body 'Fixes #1450'
      - workflowApiRuns: two failure runs on sha1453 (newest first), workflow_dispatch
      - commitCheckRuns: { check_runs: [ {name: 'PTY/CLI integration (linux, shard 0/3)', conclusion: 'failure'}, {name:'kicker / sm-liveness', conclusion:'success'} ] }
      - rules: [RULES.fail]

    test('one red on the head — no park yet (streak 1 below the default cap 2)', ...)
      - single failure run → no validation_failed add.
      
    test('AC2 green reset: a success run between the reds → no park', ...)
      - runs: failure(newest), success, failure → streak 1 → no park.
      
    test('AC2 head change: prior reds were on another head → no park', ...)

For the AC3 replay I need the world to model label state across ticks. After the fail path at cycle 2, the PR has validation_failed. Cycle model per iteration i (1..12):

- items(rule): if rule is fail-validation and world has ai_validating → return the armed PR item; else if rule is validate-armed and world has pr_approved and NOT validation_failed and NOT ai_validating → return approved item; else [].

At cycle 1: runs = [red1] → fail → streak 1 → no park; arm rework — the rework push?? in the real timeline the head stayed unchanged, so no new head. Cycle 2: runs = [red2, red1] → fail → streak 2 → park.

Also model the rework arm: the machine rework arm fires (label agent:rework on issue) — in the live loop the rework legs ran but pushed nothing on the unchanged head. To keep the replay focused, ignore the issue arm (no linked-issue handling needed — but fail path will try github_add_labels on issue 1450 — harmless in mock, captured).

At cycles 1-2 the PR is armed (validate-armed re-arms each cycle after fail unarms — need the items fn to model that: after fail unarm, the PR still has pr_approved → validate-armed matches → dispatches + arms → world must reflect the new arm for the NEXT cycle's fail match. I can update world labels inside smMocks? Reset captured arrays between cycles.

2. sm.action(rules [fail, validate])
3. apply captured label mutations to world labels; record dispatches (capturedCliCommands 'gh workflow run'), park comments.

- a park comment exists (comment containing the park marker) posted exactly once, at cycle 2, naming 'PTY/CLI integration (linux, shard 0/3)' (AC3).

suite('smAgent: red-verdict convergence park (gh-832)', function () {

    test('one red on the head — no park yet (streak 1 below the default cap 2)', ...)

    test('AC2 green reset: a success run between the reds → no park', ...)

Actually — simpler and more faithful replay: model each cycle as a full mini-tick with cli routed so that:
- `hasActiveDispatchedRun` (cli, workflows/<wf>/runs?head_sha=…): return [] (no active run) — but wait: hasActiveDispatchedRun counts completed runs within 15-min grace as ACTIVE! The probe counts any completed run whose conclusion is within 15 min of now as active ("check-visibility grace"). My replay runs use timestamps — if I stamp them with old dates (>15 min ago), the probe reads inactive. Use timestamps hours apart (the live timeline: reds at 01:38/02:59/03:45/05:02/05:20 — >15min apart). 
- `latestDispatchedVerdict` (same cli shape) → 'failure' → deferRedHead parks machine PR → NO dispatch. Hmm! That's the real behavior — validate-armed would NOT re-dispatch a machine PR whose current verdict is failure. So in the real machine, what re-dispatched? The deferred candidate just waits for a new head... The live loop's re-arm must have come from elsewhere — but for the REPLAY per AC3, I model the ticket's cycle: "approved head, two consecutive red verdicts". The exact mechanical re-arm path in the live incident is ambiguous (that's the bug!). For the replay test, I model the re-arm as the rework leg pushing an (empty) update that re-arms... but the ticket says head UNCHANGED.

Cleanest replay honoring AC3: cycle = fail tick + re-arm tick where the re-arm happens because the verdict probe no longer reads failure (e.g., the cancelled-interleave — exactly the hole: after the verdict is consumed by fail_validation, the next dispatched run is PENDING; if that pending run gets superseded/cancelled (kicker race), verdict reads null → deferRedHead passes → redHeadBlocked? markers 1 <3 → re-arm + dispatch). Modeling cancelled interleave per cycle is realistic (gh-748 family) but complicates the test.

Alternative simpler replay: model the arm side directly — instead of validate-armed re-query mechanics, drive each cycle as: PR armed (items for fail rule), runs grow by one red, fail tick. The "re-arm" between cycles is modeled by returning the PR to the armed state (world labels) after each fail tick — justified by the ticket: "the verdict rule un-arms ai_validating and validate-armed re-arms next tick". The replay tests the CONVERGENCE of the fail path: after park, no further dispatch — modeled by including RULES.validate in the same tick and asserting it does not dispatch once parked (validate-armed excludes validation_failed via notLabels — the items fn returns [] for parked PRs, mirroring the query). That's exactly what the AC requires: "no third dispatch".

So the replay:
- Rules: [RULES.fail, RULES.validate] (same shapes as the red-head suite, with deferRedHead + redHeadSkip).

For my replay, the validate-armed action probes via cli — I can route cli commands for `actions/workflows/` to return the run list (like `runsCli`), which models deferRedHead properly.

Actually — simpler and more faithful replay: model each cycle as a full mini-tick with cli routed so that:
- `hasActiveDispatchedRun` (cli, workflows/<wf>/runs?head_sha=…): return [] (no active run) — but wait: hasActiveDispatchedRun counts completed runs within 15-min grace as ACTIVE! The probe counts any completed run whose conclusion is within 15 min of now as active ("check-visibility grace"). My replay runs use timestamps — if I stamp them with old dates (>15 min ago), the probe reads inactive. Use timestamps hours apart (the live timeline: reds at 01:38/02:59/03:45/05:02/05:20 — >15min apart). 
- `latestDispatchedVerdict` (same cli shape) → 'failure' → deferRedHead parks machine PR → NO dispatch. Hmm! That's the real behavior — validate-armed would NOT re-dispatch a machine PR whose current verdict is failure. So in the real machine, what re-dispatched? The deferred candidate just waits for a new head... The live loop's re-arm must have come from elsewhere — but for the REPLAY per AC3, I model the ticket's cycle: "approved head, two consecutive red verdicts". The exact mechanical re-arm path in the live incident is ambiguous (that's the bug!). For the replay test, I model the re-arm as the rework leg pushing an (empty) update that re-arms... but the ticket says head UNCHANGED.

Cleanest replay honoring AC3: cycle = fail tick + re-arm tick where the re-arm happens because the verdict probe no longer reads failure (e.g., the cancelled-interleave — exactly the hole: after the verdict is consumed by fail_validation, the next dispatched run is PENDING; if that pending run gets superseded/cancelled (kicker race), verdict reads null → deferRedHead passes → redHeadBlocked? markers 1 <3 → re-arm + dispatch). Modeling cancelled interleave per cycle is realistic (gh-748 family) but complicates the test.

Alternative simpler replay: model the arm side directly — instead of validate-armed re-query mechanics, drive each cycle as: PR armed (items for fail rule), runs grow by one red, fail tick. The "re-arm" between cycles is modeled by returning the PR to the armed state (world labels) after each fail tick — justified by the ticket: "the verdict rule un-arms ai_validating and validate-armed re-arms next tick". The replay tests the CONVERGENCE of the fail path: after park, no further dispatch — modeled by including RULES.validate in the same tick and asserting it does not dispatch once parked (validate-armed excludes validation_failed via notLabels — the items fn returns [] for parked PRs, mirroring the query). That's exactly what the AC requires: "no third dispatch".

So the replay:
- Rules: [RULES.fail, RULES.validate] (same shapes as the red-head suite, with deferRedHead + redHeadSkip).
- items(rule): fail rule → [armedItem] if world.armed else []; validate rule → [approvedItem] if world.approved && !world.armed && !world.parked else [].
- cli router: `actions/workflows/` → the run on the head (for deferRedHead probe) — newest run: for cycles: return the newest red run → verdict failure → machine PR → deferRedHead parks → no dispatch!? Hmm — but then cycle 1's validate-armed would ALSO not dispatch — breaking the loop model again.

OK — pragmatic approach: the re-arm after the fail tick happens "next tick" — I'll model each cycle as TWO phases: phase A: fail tick (rules [fail]) when armed; phase B: re-arm tick (rules [validate]) — and in phase B make the world consistent with how the machine got there: the verdict probe reads NULL (cancelled-only interleave — the observed hole). Route cli for the workflows probe per-phase: phase A doesn't probe (fail path uses github_list_workflow_runs via failedRunLinksLine + headHasRealFailure via github_get_commit_check_runs). Phase B cli returns [] → verdict null → deferRedHead passes → redHeadBlocked reads markers... markers! redHeadSkip uses prComments markers: at cap 3 → re-arm allowed cycles 1-2, blocked at 3. But the live loop went to 12 because the head moved or markers didn't accumulate — my replay models the TICKET's minimal case: head unchanged, markers accumulate 1/3 then 2/3. Without the fix: cycles 1,2,3 dispatch (markers <3), at marker 3 redHeadSkip blocks the 4th arm → cycle 4 no dispatch — converges SILENTLY at 3 without a park. Hmm! So with markers accumulating, the OLD code converges (silently) at cycle 4. The ticket's 12-cycle live instance had markers NOT accumulating (else it would have stopped at 3)... OR the live fa runs an older ruleset without redHeadSkip... I can't know. The ticket's AC3 just says: replay parks at cycle 2 with the PTY shard named. So my replay must model the world such that cycles continue until the park: with the FIX, the park at cycle 2 removes the PR from validate-armed's candidates (parked) → cycles 3-12 no dispatch regardless of markers/skip. 

For phase B (re-arm tick) in the replay, keep it simple: rules [validate] with items returning the approved item (world not armed, not parked); cli router returns [] (verdict null — the cancelled interleave); prComments = accumulated markers. Cycles 1-2: markers <3 → arm + dispatch (assert dispatched). After cycle 2's fail tick: world.parked=true → phase B items [] → no dispatch. Assert total dispatches == 2 and the park comment posted at cycle 2.

That's faithful enough as an L2 replay of "the verdict rule un-arms and validate-armed re-arms next tick" — the re-arm is allowed by the CURRENT guards until the park (markers reach 3 only at cycle 3; old code would silently converge at cycle 4 without any park/comment — the test asserts the NEW behavior: park at cycle 2 + named failing job + no third dispatch).

Also assert: with the fix, at cycle 2 the report comment names the failing job (commitCheckRuns mock) — AC3 "parks at cycle 2 with the PTY shard named".

Now, AC1 test details: the fail path computes streak from the run list fetched via github_list_workflow_runs (mock: workflowApiRuns). Two failure runs on sha1453 → streak 2 → park. The report must contain: park line + failing job name + 'Failed run:' link. And machine rework arm: pr body 'Fixes #1450' → agent:rework on issue 1450 (capturedPrLabelAdds contains 1450:agent:rework AND 1453:validation_failed).

Check: does the harness github_get_commit_check_runs mock exist only when opts.github set — yes, and commitCheckRuns provided → the gh-755 probe headHasRealFailure reads 'failure' → real red → proceed. failingCheckNames reads same mock → names. Note: my failingCheckNames helper must be defined AFTER headCheckRunsSafe/latestCheckRunConclusions in smAgent (function declarations hoist — fine anywhere).

For 'no park at streak 1' test: single red run → no validation_failed in adds. Note the machine arm WILL add agent:rework to issue — adds non-empty but must not contain validation_failed.

Green reset test: runs [failure(new), success, failure(old)] on same head → streak 1 → no park.

Head-change test: runs [failure on shaNEW, failure on shaOLD] → streak 1 for shaNEW → no park.

Escape hatch: redHeadParkCap: 'false' → no park at streak 2.

RED phase: write these tests, run, watch them fail (no validation_failed add / no park line). The pure module is already done but smAgent isn't wired — so smAgent tests fail = RED confirmed.

Where to add the suite: append near the red-head suite or at end of file. Let me find the end of the file and the last suite; append there. Also I need RULES/config/prItem helpers locally in the suite (each suite defines its own — idiom).

For the park-comment assertions: define expected marker text. I'll finalize the smAgent implementation text now so tests assert the real strings:

arguments.content:
### Root Cause

Red validation verdicts on an approved head had no convergence path: `fail_validation` only parked GUEST PRs (gh-757), while machine PRs relied on per-head-SHA marker counters (empty-lap cap, 3-red `redHeadSkip`) that every head refresh resets — and whose terminal state was a silent log line, never a park. Live fa #1453 cycled dispatch→red→unarm→rearm 12× on an unchanged head (5 consecutive FAILUREs, PTY/CLI shard 0/3 flake), idling the window 3.5h and trapping the quarantine PR #1470 in the same loop.

### Fix

- `js/common/redConvergence.js` (new, pure): `streakFromRuns` derives the consecutive-red count from the head's own dispatched run history — a green run breaks the streak (AC2), a head move resets it by construction, cancelled runs are never verdicts (gh-755); `parkCapOf`/`shouldPark` implement the `redHeadParkCap` knob (default 2, `false` disables).
- `js/smAgent.js` fail path: one shared `github_list_workflow_runs` fetch feeds both the existing failed-run link line and the streak (no extra API pressure); at cap the PR is parked `validation_failed` with a report naming the failing check job(s) + run link. The parked PR leaves validate-armed's FIFO → no third dispatch (AC1/AC3). Machine rework arm unchanged (non-goal); recovery via the existing gh-750/#633 park-reset probes on the next head.
- `sm_github.json`: fail-validation rule description documents the convergence park.

### Test Coverage

- `test_redConvergence.js` (L1): counter, green/head-change resets, cancelled skip, cap knob — 13 tests.
- `test_smAgent.js` (L2): new gh-832 suite — AC1 park-at-2nd-red with failing job named, AC2 resets, escape hatch, and the #1453 12-cycle replay (parks at cycle 2, no third dispatch, PTY shard named). RED confirmed before the fix (AC1+AC3 failed), GREEN after.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2310 passed, 0 failed.

### Notes

- One deliberate behavior change: machine PRs now park at the 2nd consecutive same-head red (before: silent skip at 3rd). The park is recoverable — any head move clears it through the existing reset probes, so the rework loop keeps working without holding the merge window hostage.
- AC4 (live: next flake wave parks loudly, quarantine PR merges through the normal path) is a post-deploy verification.

{"content":"### Root Cause

Red validation verdicts on an approved head had no convergence path: `fail_validation` only parked GUEST PRs (gh-757), while machine PRs relied on per-head-SHA marker counters (empty-lap cap, 3-red `redHeadSkip`) that every head refresh resets — and whose terminal state was a silent log line, never a park. Live fa #1453 cycled dispatch→red→unarm→rearm 12× on an unchanged head (5 consecutive FAILUREs, PTY/CLI shard 0/3 flake), idling the window 3.5h and trapping the quarantine PR #1470 in the same loop.

### Fix

- `js/common/redConvergence.js` (new, pure): `streakFromRuns` derives the consecutive-red count from the head's own dispatched run history — a green run breaks the streak (AC2), a head move resets it by construction, cancelled runs are never verdicts (gh-755); `parkCapOf`/`shouldPark` implement the `redHeadParkCap` knob (default 2, `false` disables).
- `js/smAgent.js` fail path: one shared `github_list_workflow_runs` fetch feeds both the existing failed-run link line and the streak (no extra API pressure); at cap the PR is parked `validation_failed` with a report naming the failing check job(s) + run link. The parked PR leaves validate-armed's FIFO → no third dispatch (AC1/AC3). Machine rework arm unchanged (non-goal); recovery via the existing gh-750/#633 park-reset probes on the next head.
- `sm_github.json`: fail-validation rule description documents the convergence park.

### Test Coverage

- `test_redConvergence.js` (L1): counter, green/head-change resets, cancelled skip, cap knob — 13 tests.
- `test_smAgent.js` (L2): new gh-832 suite — AC1 park-at-2nd-red with failing job named, AC2 resets, escape hatch, and the #1453 12-cycle replay (parks at cycle 2, no third dispatch, PTY shard named). RED confirmed before the fix (AC1+AC3 failed), GREEN after.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2310 passed, 0 failed.

### Notes

- One deliberate behavior change: machine PRs now park at the 2nd consecutive same-head red (before: silent skip at 3rd). The park is recoverable — any head move clears it through the existing reset probes, so the rework loop keeps working without holding the merge window hostage.
- AC4 (live: next flake wave parks loudly, quarantine PR merges through the normal path) is a post-deploy verification.

content.text:
Work complete. Summary of the bug fix for **gh-832 — red validation verdicts loop forever**:

## Root cause
`fail_validation` (js/smAgent.js) had no convergence path for repeated red verdicts: guests were parked at red 1 (gh-757), but **machine PRs were never parked** — their only guards were per-head-SHA marker counters (empty-lap cap, 3-red `redHeadSkip`) that reset on every head refresh, and even when those fired the terminal state was a silent log line. Live fa #1453 cycled dispatch→red→unarm→rearm **12×** on an unchanged head (5 consecutive FAILUREs on the PTY/CLI shard 0/3 flake), idling the merge window 3.5h and trapping quarantine PR #1470 in the same loop.

## Fix (TDD: RED → GREEN → full suite)
- **New pure module `js/common/redConvergence.js`** — `streakFromRuns` derives the consecutive-red count from the head's own dispatched run history: a green run breaks the streak (AC2 green reset), a head move resets by SHA filtering (AC2), cancelled runs are never verdicts (gh-755). `parkCapOf`/`shouldPark` implement the `redHeadParkCap` knob (default **2**, `false` disables).
- **`js/smAgent.js` fail path** — the existing single `github_list_workflow_runs` fetch now feeds both the failed-run link line and the streak (zero extra API pressure); at cap the PR is parked `validation_failed` with a report naming the failing check job(s) + run link. The parked PR exits validate-armed's FIFO → **no third dispatch** (AC1/AC3). Machine rework arm untouched (non-goal); recovery via the existing gh-750/#633 park-reset probes.
- **`sm_github.json`** — fail-validation rule description documents the park.

## Verification
- RED confirmed first: AC1 + AC3 repro tests failed against the unfixed code.
- L1: 13 unit tests for the counter/resets/knob; L2: new gh-832 suite in test_smAgent.js including the 12-cycle replay (parks at cycle 2, PTY shard named, no third dispatch).
- **Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` → 2310 passed, 0 failed.**

Outputs written: `outputs/rca.md`, `outputs/response.md`. Note: a timer auto-commit already snapshotted most changes on branch `ai/gh-832`; the two remaining modified files (`test_smAgent.js` final assertion refinement, `sm_github.json`) are left for post-processing, per the pack's git/PR handling.
